acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained as a structural gate; rework must add the missing paired-prefix, provenance, path-credit, and shortcut tests.
Retained as a role-boundary gate; rework must define history-conditioned noninterference and query/agenda channel tests.
Retained as a phase gate; rework must bind GOALS_COMPLETE, repeat/retry state, and provenance chronology.
Retained as a carrier gate; exposure, uncertainty, and complete resource factors remain unbound.
Retained as a root-unit reducer gate; exact failure and negative-result dispositions remain required.
Retained for scoped source/descendant denial; the OS/session/provider authority boundary must be bound.
Retained for local atomicity; the concrete journal/CAS and recovery protocol remain unbound.
Retained as the DEV text relay gate; it does not cover the missing stage endpoints, recurrence, or bypass controls.
Retained as a noncompensatory placeholder only; a later exact hash-bound E0 package is required.
Retained as downstream same-semantics transport; it cannot establish fixed-memory or fixed-compute comparison.
Retained as baseline/plumbing certification only; it does not execute CLM-L's ordered end-to-end gates.
Retained as the C entry point; accounting, decoder-denial, and endpoint separations must be bound.

agreements: CPU passage can establish deterministic software, visibility, intervention, reducer, and scoped local-isolation properties only; it is not learning evidence.
M, L, and C require distinct independent units, reducers, artifacts, and claim boundaries.
Explicit-text M and an independently ratified E0 gate must precede any interpretable LoRA transport claim.
The clean source must remain read-only and experimental descendant state must not promote upstream.
L's shared exogenous opportunity tape supports a longitudinal-use estimand, not an on-policy action-experience flywheel.
C is a semantic-code rate--distortion experiment; LoRA is transport unless complete charged state crosses a measured physical-byte threshold.

Hashes and receipts authenticate scoped bytes and execution records but do not establish semantic target blindness, provider statelessness, administrator noninterference, or absence of human causal input.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the proposal expressly leaves outcome-changing fields unset, so no exact executable contract exists.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Exact-byte ratification and implementation must not proceed while material benchmark, visibility, reducer, and estimand fields remain unset.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: static private-byte wording conflicts with legitimate post-action public divergence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind paired-world prefix indistinguishability and permit visible divergence only through a registered ordinary public consequence of an actor action.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: derived goal visibility leaves carrier/query laundering untested.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add capability-level tests proving that goals and private schedules cannot influence carrier authorship, query agendas, retrieval ordering, candidate catalogs, or padding except through explicitly legal public anchors.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: no exact join projection prevents assessment of abandoned-branch leakage.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define the exact GOALS_COMPLETE join and prove that abandoned or sibling thinker branches release only the prebound public projection.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: retry and repeat semantics are presently hidden controller behavior.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make repeat and retry state explicit in the actor-visible schema and exhaustively test FOUND, NOT_FOUND, blocked, reset, and replay transitions.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: model-facing bytes are not frozen.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind canonical encodings, prompts, chat templates, operation schemas, parsers, and golden fully rendered bytes before any model-facing acceptance test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: unresolved producer makes DREAM authorship non-identifiable.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind one target-independent public-evidence link producer and restrict deterministic SLEEP to validation and rendering, or narrow the claim to use of externally supplied linked memory.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: chronology and root-equivalence provenance properties are not registered.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add an explicit provenance-DAG suite covering chronological support, root deduplication, synthetic re-expression, aliases, legal diamonds, true cycles, descendant citations, and revocation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: certificates establish available paths, not behavioral causal use.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Separate legal path, answer, and shortcut scores; accept registered path-equivalence classes; and require counterfactual trace dependence before awarding composition credit.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: assigned-structure ablations do not establish recurrent necessity or comparative utility.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add recurrence removal and major bypass baselines using the same public evidence and declared resource envelopes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: a bundled relay gate permits passive-recall interpretations.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Create noncompensatory stage endpoints that distinguish recall, generalization, composition, planning, action improvement, revision, and retention.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the uncertainty assay remains an unbound source of action asymmetry.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind and balance the uncertainty assay and score experiment choice separately from realized information and later action value.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: same semantics and visible-return matching do not equalize complete resource factors.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Report and ablate text context, explicit graph state, reader/index computation, LoRA transport, and thinker computation as separate factors; do not imply fixed-memory or fixed-compute equivalence.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: bounded M and exogenous L are distinct from an ongoing adaptive acquisition loop.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep bounded M, exogenous L, and any on-policy flywheel as distinct claims, and add a separately ratified online-learning assay if the directive's action-experience loop remains a target.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the sole L test is a prerequisite, not CLM-L evidence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a distinct L end-to-end acceptance test implementing every ordered noncompensatory CLM-L gate.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: no claim-bearing estimator or threshold policy is executable.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Prospectively bind sample sizes or sample-size rules, splits, margins, estimators, uncertainty, multiplicity, and stopping before claim-bearing execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: lineage no-return does not close partial-result feedback into later units.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a complete confirmation decision DAG and add partial-result, retry, schedule, release, and post-hoc selection attacks.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: permissions fixtures without a declared authority boundary cannot support the proposed scope.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Ratify an explicit OS/VM and session-isolation boundary, test ambient channels and direct-helper bypass, and narrow claims wherever provider, administrator, or human channels remain trusted.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: atomic rename is not sufficient to define a conditional local commit.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify the concrete journal/CAS protocol and enumerate every durability boundary before treating LINEAGE-02 as deterministic.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the exact independent prerequisite is absent from this hash-bound chain.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the exact E0 package and evidence hashes in a later approval before allowing E0 passage to unlock M-LORA-01.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: codec costs and distortion endpoints are underdetermined.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind standalone and amortized decoder/accounting rules, prohibit or charge generator access, and separate codec fidelity from model utility and false-memory endpoints.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: neither M's one relay nor C's within-root loads establishes accumulation or developmental scale.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add repeated within-life accumulation and factorized scale tests before making increasing-lifetime, accumulation, saturation, or scaling statements.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: adverse cell retention alone does not prebind the claim consequence of every failure.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Prebind failure dispositions, mandatory reporting, claim withdrawal, and pivot boundaries so negative results cannot trigger silent goalpost movement.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposal is exact enough for implementation.

positions.position: A staged architecture can be ratified while exact semantic and inferential fields are deferred.
Unset fields change benchmark meaning and must be bound before implementation.

resolution.rationale: Select rework: the current registry invokes ratified but absent contracts, so it cannot make a Stage-0 implementation exact.
resolution.required_change: Bind all presently unset benchmark, visibility, reducer, estimand, isolation, and claim fields in a repaired hash-bound proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether existing CPU wording closes pre-action paired-world shortcuts.

positions.position: Private-byte noninterference and root certificates are sufficient.
Prefix byte collision and balance laws must be explicit, with divergence only after a separating action.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark position; the literal current noninterference condition is otherwise impossible or weak.
resolution.required_change: Bind a history-conditioned prefix-collision and balance law.

disagreements.issue: Whether goal-derived compiler visibility can be safely left specification-dependent.

positions.position: Compiler access is legal when admitted by its specification.
Without an anchor and agenda law, target information can be laundered into carrier construction.

resolution.required_change: Bind legal public anchors and test query-to-agenda noninterference.

disagreements.issue: What probe information may join the acquisition trunk.

positions.position: A ratified public GOALS_COMPLETE projection is sufficient placeholder language.
The exact public join and eligibility chronology must be bound.

resolution.rationale: Select the systems position to prevent either no usable evidence or branch leakage.
resolution.required_change: Bind GOALS_COMPLETE bytes and excluded branch state.

disagreements.issue: Whether repeat/retry state can remain implicit.

positions.position: The phase machine and root receipt suffice.
Hidden repeat and reset state changes recurrence and failure semantics.

resolution.required_change: Bind actor-visible repeat fingerprints, counts, blocks, reset reasons, and replay behavior.

disagreements.issue: Whether model-facing encoding may be chosen later.

positions.position: Canonical encodings are a later ratification item.
Prompt, parser, tokenizer, and normalization ambiguity invalidates model-facing interpretation.

resolution.required_change: Bind one canonical encoding and golden rendered model-facing bytes.

disagreements.issue: Whether deterministic compilation may author authentic links.

positions.position: DREAM proposals or deterministic compilation may supply carriers.
Oracle-adjacent compilation changes the estimand to use of supplied annotations.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark position unless claims are narrowed.
resolution.required_change: Bind a public-evidence DREAM producer or narrow the claim to supplied-memory use.

disagreements.issue: Whether support provenance requirements are sufficiently specified.

positions.position: Chronological support is described in loop prose.
Diamonds, aliases, duplicate roots, cycles, and revocation need executable tests.

resolution.required_change: Bind provenance-DAG identities and the complete adversarial suite.

disagreements.issue: Whether root certificates establish actual constructive use.

positions.position: Different paths and necessary bridges certify the intended task.
Behavior requires dependency traces and counterfactual masking before composition credit.

resolution.required_change: Bind path-equivalence, trace-dependence, masking, and twin-substitution criteria.

disagreements.issue: Whether current M controls establish recurrent mechanism utility.

positions.position: Bridge, twin, and carrier controls are adequate relay contrasts.
Recurrence-disabled and major bypass baselines are required for that interpretation.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark position; no registered test currently supplies the required controls.
resolution.required_change: Rework the proposal to register recurrence and bypass tests; do not infer them from M-TEXT-01.

disagreements.issue: Whether one bundled M relay gate is mechanistically diagnostic.

positions.position: A root-level relay gate can test the intended bundle.
Recall, composition, planning, action, revision, information, and retention require noncompensatory endpoints.

resolution.required_change: Register distinct noncompensatory endpoints before interpreting passage.

disagreements.issue: Whether the separating-action assay is already identified.

positions.position: Authentic versus sham uncertainty is named as a control.
The object, action set, costs, outcomes, ties, and scoring are unresolved.

resolution.required_change: Bind and balance the full uncertainty decision instrument.

disagreements.issue: Whether same-semantics text/LoRA comparison is fixed-memory comparison.

positions.position: Matched semantic rows and exposure support carrier attribution.
They support transport only because complete bytes, work, and interfaces differ.

resolution.required_change: Limit reporting to same-semantics transport unless a separately registered charged budget sweep exists.

disagreements.issue: Whether M plus exogenous L establishes an action-experience flywheel.

positions.position: The combined architecture describes recurrent later DREAM cycles.
M is bounded and L deliberately removes adaptive acquisition effects.

resolution.required_change: Keep these estimands separate and require a later ratified on-policy assay for flywheel claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether L-BASELINE-01 supports CLM-L.

positions.position: Baseline certification and plumbing are L prerequisites.
No current test measures the ordered plateau, slope, retention, terminal, and uncertainty gates.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark position; no registered acceptance test covers CLM-L.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a new L end-to-end test; L-BASELINE-01 remains prerequisite only.

disagreements.issue: Whether future packages can supply all estimand rules after implementation.

positions.position: Later packages can bind execution details.
Current claim-bearing acceptance language has no prospectively executable inference contract.

resolution.required_change: Bind split, units, margins, failures, estimators, uncertainty, multiplicity, and stopping before claim-bearing execution.

disagreements.issue: Whether no-return and terminal-result rows prevent result-conditioned selection.

positions.position: Terminal results are forbidden to controller and upstream source.
Partial metrics and operational signals can still alter future units and decisions.

resolution.required_change: Bind a confirmation decision DAG and attacks on partial-release and schedule feedback.

disagreements.issue: Whether the lineage surface belongs to the pure CPU kernel and what it enforces.

positions.position: The combined graph includes broad lineage authority and role isolation.
Keep a minimum claim-bearing guard separate from TEST_ONLY/DEV_NONCLAIM kernel work and state trust limits.

resolution.rationale: Select the systems position, but its authority substrate is still unbound.
resolution.required_change: Rework with a scoped OS/process/session/cache/RNG authority boundary and explicit claim limits.

disagreements.issue: Whether stated atomicity is a complete transaction protocol.

positions.position: Expected-head promotion and crash/race tests specify the desired property.
Slots, CAS primitive, durability order, recovery, and unreachable blobs remain undefined.

resolution.required_change: Bind the journal/CAS implementation contract and every crash boundary.

disagreements.issue: Whether a referenced later E0 assay is an executable prerequisite in this proposal.

positions.position: E0 is independently ratified elsewhere and noncompensatory.
No exact E0 artifact or hash is bound here, so its gate cannot be audited or unlocked.

resolution.required_change: Require a later exact hash-bound E0 approval before any M-LORA-01 passage.

disagreements.issue: Whether C-CODEC-01 fixes decoder cost and distortion semantics.

positions.position: It charges complete retained bytes and work.
Standalone/amortized schema, decoder, generator, index, and endpoint separations remain unspecified.

resolution.required_change: Bind accounting, deny or charge generator access, and separate fidelity, utility, and false-memory endpoints.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed M/L/C suite tests repeated within-life accumulation or scale.

positions.position: M has an old-plus-new relay, L has cuts, and C has ordered loads.
Those are not repeated supported-edge accumulation, factorized developmental scale, or continued-improvement evidence.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark position; no existing registered test covers the requested accumulation surface.
resolution.required_change: Rework with repeated within-life accumulation and factorized scale tests before those claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether adverse value retention fully constrains failed scientific cells.

positions.position: Reducers retain prespecified adverse values.
Claim withdrawal, reporting, and pivot consequences remain unbound across failures.

resolution.required_change: Bind mandatory reporting and claim-withdrawal dispositions for every failed or unrun gate.

disagreements.issue: Whether CPU certificates can falsify or establish experiential use.

positions.position: CPU certificates are listed as falsifying M identifiability.
They establish instrument preconditions, not actor use.

resolution.required_change: Restrict CPU language to instrument and software properties.

disagreements.issue: Whether terminal descendants can persist local L state.

positions.position: All experiment learning is root-local and terminal.
Terminal must mean upstream-terminal; L state persists across registered cuts.

resolution.required_change: Define terminal as no upstream promotion, not no registered descendant persistence.

questions: Ratify a repaired exact proposal only after all required missing tests, semantics, isolation, and inferential contracts are hash-bound.

Decide whether the requested scientific scope is narrowed to a bounded supplied-memory/text relay or retains DREAM authorship, accumulation, L, fixed-budget, online, and confirmation claims requiring additional registered tests.

Accepted; producer must be bound or claim narrowed.
Accepted; missing controls require proposal rework.
Accepted; current tests do not support accumulation or scale claims.
Accepted; CLM-L has no registered end-to-end acceptance test.
